rationale: The Latin anchor *auctoritas* (power, right, authority) combined with the attestation context of a bishop exercising *pontificali auctoritate* (episcopal/pontifical authority) points directly to the sense of power or right to give orders or make decisions — i.e., authority.n.01. The personal, institutional power of a church official rules out the plural-persons sense (n.02), the expert sense (n.03), or written-work sense (n.07).
